anchors.name: Gold SUM(revenue) – agg_sales_monthly
anchors.sql: SELECT SUM(revenue) FROM gold.agg_sales_monthly;

anchors.name: Gold SUM(price) – fact_order_items (is_valid_sale)
anchors.sql: SELECT SUM(price) FROM gold.fact_order_items WHERE is_valid_sale;

anchors.name: kpi_monthly có 20 tháng
anchors.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM analytics.kpi_monthly;

anchors.name: kpi_monthly không chứa 2016 và 2018-09
anchors.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM analytics.kpi_monthly
WHERE purchase_year = 2016 OR (purchase_year = 2018 AND purchase_month >= 9);

anchors.name: Tổng revenue kpi_monthly (nhỏ hơn gold vì cắt tháng rỗng)
anchors.sql: SELECT SUM(revenue) FROM analytics.kpi_monthly;

anchors.name: Tháng đỉnh doanh thu
anchors.sql: SELECT month_label FROM presentation.v_kpi_monthly ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 1;

anchors.name: MoM tháng đỉnh (%)
anchors.sql: SELECT revenue_mom_pct FROM presentation.v_kpi_monthly ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 1;

anchors.name: Review đơn trễ
anchors.sql: SELECT avg_review FROM analytics.insight_late_vs_review WHERE delivery = 'late';

anchors.name: Review đơn đúng hạn
anchors.sql: SELECT avg_review FROM analytics.insight_late_vs_review WHERE delivery = 'on_time';

anchors.name: Số khách mua lại (frequency ≥ 2)
anchors.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM analytics.rfm_scores WHERE frequency >= 2;

anchors.name: Tổng khách thật (customer_unique_id)
anchors.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_unique_id) FROM analytics.rfm_scores;

anchors.name: Tỷ lệ khách mua lại (%)
anchors.sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE frequency >= 2) / COUNT(*), 2) FROM analytics.rfm_scores;

anchors.name: Tỷ lệ frequency = 1 (%)
anchors.sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE frequency = 1) / COUNT(*), 2) FROM analytics.rfm_scores;

anchors.name: Seller watchlist
anchors.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM analytics.seller_watchlist;

anchors.name: Số seller tạo ≤80% doanh thu
anchors.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM analytics.seller_pareto WHERE cumulative_share_pct <= 80;

anchors.name: Nhất quán: SUM(revenue) v_orders = SUM(revenue) kpi_monthly
anchors.sql: SELECT (SELECT SUM(revenue) FROM presentation.v_orders) - (SELECT SUM(revenue) FROM analytics.kpi_monthly);

anchors.name: Nhất quán: COUNT đơn v_orders = SUM(orders) kpi_monthly
anchors.sql: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM presentation.v_orders) - (SELECT SUM(orders) FROM analytics.kpi_monthly);

anchors.name: Nhất quán: SUM(revenue) v_sales_items = SUM(revenue) kpi_monthly
anchors.sql: SELECT (SELECT SUM(revenue) FROM presentation.v_sales_items) - (SELECT SUM(revenue) FROM analytics.kpi_monthly);

anchors.name: Nhất quán: tổng khách theo segment = tổng khách RFM
anchors.sql: SELECT SUM(customers) FROM presentation.v_rfm_segments;

anchors.name: Số dòng gợi ý quyết định
anchors.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM presentation.v_decision_hints;
